verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox is API/SDK-first by design: SDKs are described as 'the recommended way' to create sandboxes, run commands, and manage files, with CLI and dashboard as secondary interfaces, and an OpenAPI spec exists at the platform level. Core capabilities (create, run commands blocking/detached, snapshots, persistence, tags, custom images, timeouts) are all documented as programmatic operations, with the dashboard mainly offering supplementary actions like stopping sandboxes.
